title: Marketing Manager (Online & Offline)
description:
Role: Lead and execute Watchpalaces online and offline marketing activities to increase brand awareness, customer engagement, store footfall, and sales. 
 Responsibilities: 
 - Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across Instagram, Facebook, Google & WhatsApp. - Manage Meta Ads, Google Ads and website promotions. - Plan local marketing activities, store promotions and events. - Coordinate with influencers, local pages and creative teams. - Develop marketing campaigns for new store launches and existing stores. - Track campaign performance, leads, sales and marketing ROI. - Plan monthly marketing calendars and execute campaigns on time. - Coordinate online and offline marketing to maintain consistent Watchpalace branding.Role & responsibilities

Key Skills: Offline Marketing,Online Marketing,Marketing,Management,Marketing management,Offline
